text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Tracen Academy's annual summer camp, and Sakura Chiyono O is fired up from day one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to improve and reignite the fire in Maruzensky's engine, which has been left idle for far too long.
